scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported Anguthimri polygon covers 1600 to 1815 near western Cape York. The card uses documented Mpakwithi examples, not a claim that every variety or all Mapoon residents are interchangeable. Tjungundji Country is distinguished from a mission’s later multi-community population.
Awngthim is not treated as an alias merely because some databases conflate names. No imported territorial outline is certified by the language classification.
Later community records are not back-projected into the early map interval. The absence of a selected-year period for 1700 is an explicit evidence gap.

The Crowley finding aid was read, not the underlying recordings. Its caution about inaccurate early forms is respected. This card plus the Anggamudi card together derive fewer than 200 words from that PDF.

The Services Australia exhibit was read. Its linked scanned letters could not be rendered by the web tool; no additional claims from unexamined manuscript pages are made. Its inconsistent month-range description is not repeated.
The slides’ collection description was read but individual images were not visually examined. No house layout, construction detail or photographic scene is invented.

Wharton identifies Jean Jimmy’s family as probably or believed to be Yupangathi. This uncertainty is not flattened into a certain subgroup classification; her life is used as a named example in the connected Mapoon history.

The 2021 and 2023 program reports were consulted through indexed text on the identified printed pages. Provider reports establish described activities, not independent evaluations of psychological or linguistic outcomes.
Film production and festival status are attributed to the organization’s published account. The films were not watched and no later screening or prize is inferred from a planned event.
Language renewal is distinguished from uninterrupted transmission. Continuing communities are not called extinct. No unverified political successor or native title conclusion is supplied.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
